title: NXT: BirthRight meets Zilla Fatu
summary: BirthRight beats Fatu’s allies, then loses to an unexpected pairing from AAA and Evolve. Fatu stops the retaliation.

chapters.title: BirthRight (Channing Lorenzo, Lexis King & Uriah Connors) vs. EK Prosper, Sean Legacy & Zilla Fatu
chapters.result: BirthRight (Channing Lorenzo, Lexis King & Uriah Connors) (w/Arianna Grace) defeat EK Prosper, Sean Legacy & Zilla Fatu (11:03)

chapters.title: Chazz Hall & Mini Vikingo vs. BirthRight (Channing Lorenzo & Uriah Connors)
chapters.result: Chazz Hall & Mini Vikingo defeat BirthRight (Channing Lorenzo & Uriah Connors) (w/Arianna Grace, Charlie Dempsey & Lexis King) (12:12)
